drivers.defaultPrompt: Race efficiently over all three laps. Protect tyres with smooth corner entries and avoid unnecessary lane changes. Hold a productive pace rather than repeatedly accelerating and braking. Use boost sparingly for a useful pass on a straight. Weigh pit-service time against tyre grip and damage; keep the car healthy enough for the final lap. Prefer safe passes to collisions.

drivers.name: Milo
drivers.defaultPrompt: Be patient early and attack late. Save boost on the opening laps, take bends conservatively and let reckless rivals crash or pit. Keep moving at a useful pace rather than crawling. On the final lap, spend saved boost on clear straights and take an available overtaking opportunity to gain places. Accept a calculated late risk when behind; protect an existing lead.

Leave generous traffic gaps and avoid risky overtakes. Accelerate on clear straights; boost only with room to brake. Pit before damage becomes severe or tyres run low. A clean finish matters more than an early lead.
